# Population Reference Bureau (PRB)

> > PRB is a leading demographic research organization providing data-driven insights on population trends, public health, reproductive health, and social policy across the United States and globally.

The Population Reference Bureau delivers authoritative demographic analysis through its World Population Data Sheet, census research, and policy-focused reports. PRB's work spans family planning, fertility trends, child well-being, and demographic transitions in regions including the Middle East, Africa, and the United States.

## World Population Data and COVID-19 Impacts

- [PRB Releases 2022 World Population Data Sheet, Providing Comprehensive Look at COVID-19 Pandemic's Demographic Impacts in More Than 200 Countries](https://www.prb.org/news/prbs-releases-2022-world-population-data-sheet-providing-comprehensive-look-at-covid-19-pandemics-demographic-impacts-in-more-than-200-countries): 2022 World Population Data Sheet release covering COVID-19 impacts globally

## U.S. Census and Child Well-Being

- [New Report on U.S. Children's Well-Being Shows Signs of Recovery—but Gaps Remain](https://www.prb.org/news/new-report-on-u-s-childrens-well-being-shows-signs-of-recovery-but-gaps-remain): Annie E. Casey Foundation KIDS COUNT Data Book on child well-being trends
- [Reducing the Undercount of Young Children in Census 2020](https://www.prb.org/news/reducing-the-undercount-of-young-children-in-census-2020): Analysis of young children undercount challenges in 2020 U.S. Census
- [2020 U.S. Census Self-Response Rates Are Lagging in Neighborhoods at Risk of Undercounting Young Children](https://www.prb.org/news/2020-us-census-self-response-rates-are-lagging-in-neighborhoods): 2020 Census self-response rates analysis for young children undercount risk
- [How Many People in the United States Are Experiencing Homelessness?](https://www.prb.org/news/how-many-people-in-the-united-states-are-experiencing-homelessness): HUD methodology and statistics on U.S. homelessness measurement
- [How Is the Economic Recession Affecting U.S. Children? The 2009 Child Well-Being Index](https://www.prb.org/news/how-is-the-economic-recession-affecting-u-s-children-the-2009-child-well-being-index): Duke University's 2009 Child Well-Being Index on recession impacts

## Middle East and Iran Demographics

- [Iran's Demographic Dividend and the Implications of the Nuclear Deal](https://www.prb.org/news/irans-demographic-dividend-and-the-implications-of-the-nuclear-deal): Analysis of Iran's demographic dividend and nuclear deal implications
- [Youth, Women's Rights, and Political Change in Iran](https://www.prb.org/news/youth-womens-rights-and-political-change-in-iran): Iran's youth bulge, fertility decline, and women's rights developments
- [Can a Nuclear Deal Help Iran's Young Labor Force?](https://www.prb.org/news/can-a-nuclear-deal-help-irans-young-labor-force): Farzaneh Roudi on Iran's demographic dividend and youth employment prospects
- [PRB Report Launch: Curbing the Noncommunicable Disease Epidemic in the Middle East and North Africa](https://www.prb.org/news/prb-report-launch-curbing-the-noncommunicable-disease-epidemic-in-the-middle-east-and-north-africa): PRB report launch on NCD epidemic in MENA region at American University
- [Ending Child Marriage in the Arab Region](https://www.prb.org/news/ending-child-marriage-in-the-arab-region): Child marriage statistics and challenges in Yemen, Sudan, and Arab region

## Family Planning and Reproductive Health

- [Family Planning, Environment, and Resilience in Western Tanzania](https://www.prb.org/news/family-planning-environment-and-resilience-in-western-tanzania): Tuungane Project integrating family planning with environmental resilience
- [Event: The Role of Population and Family Planning in Peace and Security](https://www.prb.org/news/event-the-role-of-population-and-family-planning-in-peace-and-security): PACE Project event on family planning's role in peace and security policy
- [Fertility Rates in Low Birth-Rate Countries, 1996-2011](https://www.prb.org/news/fertility-rates-in-low-birth-rate-countries-1996-2011): Fertility rate trends in low birth-rate countries like Germany and Japan

## Regional Economic and Demographic Analysis

- [Incomplete Economic Recovery in Appalachia, New PRB Report Finds](https://www.prb.org/news/incomplete-economic-recovery-in-appalachia-new-prb-report-finds): PRB report on Appalachian Regional Commission economic recovery analysis
- [Demographic Impacts and Disaster Response to 2004 Hurricanes](https://www.prb.org/news/demographic-impacts-and-disaster-response-to-2004-hurricanes): Stanley Smith analyzes demographic impacts of 2004 Florida hurricanes
